items.briefing:
Australian energy provider Origin Energy is currently investigating an alleged cyber incident involving data, which serves as a reminder that no sector is immune. More broadly, Australian organisations are seeing a shift away from ransomware toward straight data theft, meaning attackers may be quietly stealing information without triggering obvious alarms. Finance teams are also being warned about behavioural attacks — scams that manipulate people psychologically rather than using technical hacking.

AI-generated bot traffic now reportedly outpaces real human web activity, increasing risks for organisations managing online platforms. Optus is also facing Federal Court action from ACMA over last year's Triple Zero outage, highlighting the serious regulatory consequences of service failures.

**Tip:** Remind your finance team to verbally verify any unusual payment requests — even if the email looks legitimate.

featured.title: Origin Energy probes alleged cyber incident over data
featured.quote: Major Australian energy provider's data breach exposes millions of customers to immediate scam risks.
